findings.title: Unclear scope of site establishment
findings.message: The short and long text "Baustelle vollständig einrichten und vorhalten" does not specify the required equipment, duration, load class or any performance criteria, which violates VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 (clear and exhaustive description).
findings.suggestion: Specify the required facilities (e.g., site office, storage, fencing), load class, stand‑time and dismantling conditions.

findings.title: Missing technical data for frost protection layer
findings.message: The description lacks material type, required thickness and performance class (e.g., thermal conductivity, frost resistance), which are mandatory according to the STLB‑Bau standard for frost protection.
findings.suggestion: Add material designation (e.g., granular frost protection, X‑type), minimum thickness (e.g., 30 mm) and required thermal conductivity or frost‑resistance class.

findings.title: Insufficient data for PE‑HD pipe delivery
findings.message: Only the nominal diameter is given. Required specifications such as pressure class, standard (e.g., DIN 8077), and type of fittings are missing, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 and the STLB‑Bau standard for pipe work.
findings.suggestion: State the pressure rating (e.g., PN 16), applicable standard (DIN 8077), and include required fittings and joint types.

findings.title: Missing concrete class and detail for shaft construction
findings.message: The text "Schacht DN 1000 aus Betonfertigteilen herstellen" does not specify the concrete strength class, reinforcement details or the type of prefabricated element, which are required by the STLB‑Bau standard for shafts.
findings.suggestion: Add concrete class (e.g., C25/30), reinforcement layout, and type of prefabricated component (e.g., precast concrete ring).

findings.title: Lacking details for masonry work
findings.message: Only "Kalksandsteinmauerwerk nach statischer Vorgabe" is stated; the required brick size, mortar type, and bonding pattern are missing, which are necessary for a complete specification.
findings.suggestion: Specify brick dimensions, mortar class (e.g., M5), and bonding pattern (e.g., stretcher bond).

findings.title: Missing plaster type and standard
findings.message: The description "Innenputz als einlagigen Putz" does not indicate the plaster material (e.g., gypsum, lime), class, or reference standard (DIN 18540).
findings.suggestion: Add plaster type, class (e.g., V2), and reference to DIN 18540.

findings.title: Insufficient data for paving slab work
findings.message: The text does not define the type of paving stones, thickness, joint material or laying method, which are required for a complete specification under VOB/A.
findings.suggestion: Specify stone type (e.g., concrete pavers), thickness (e.g., 80 mm), joint filler (e.g., sand‑cement mortar), and laying pattern.

findings.title: Missing technical data for asphalt base layer
findings.message: The description lacks required parameters such as nominal grain size, bitumen content, and minimum layer thickness, which are essential for compliance with asphalt work standards.
findings.suggestion: Add grain size class (e.g., 0/31.5), bitumen content (e.g., 5 % by weight), and minimum thickness (e.g., 100 mm).

findings.title: Missing technical data for asphalt wearing course
findings.message: The specification does not state the required surface texture, bitumen type, or minimum thickness, which are required for a complete asphalt deck layer description.
findings.suggestion: Include surface texture class, bitumen type (e.g., polymer‑modified), and minimum thickness (e.g., 50 mm).

findings.title: Potential risk shift through pauschal price
findings.message: A lump‑sum price for "Baustelleneinrichtung" may transfer the risk of completeness and duration to the contractor, which could be deemed ineffective under § 307 BGB if not clearly limited.
findings.suggestion: Define clear limits of the contractor’s obligations and separate optional services.
